Ownership and control of a card is two different things in most CCG
and are in VTES quite different.
When the owner of an event leaves play, the event doesn't leaves play.
It's when the controler of the event (most of time, yes, it's the
owner...), leaves play, that event leaves play.
And orbital mind control laser doesn't exist.
At all.
Kamel.
